10326.text:
10326 mēdya 'fatty, thick' Suśr. [Cf. mḗdyati 'is fat' RV., Pa. mejjati . — mḗdas -] A. mez 'wen' (cf. mēdō ' rbuda - n. 'fatty painful
tumour' W.); — L. mẽjh f. 'fat'; WPah.bhal. mὲnj̈ f.
'fat (usu. of sheep)': < * mejja - X * mijjha f. 'marrow'
(see majján -) in L. mijh f., P. mijjh , miñjh f. also with
unexpl. aspirate. Addenda: mēdya-: A. mez (phonet. mεz ) also 'tumour' AFD
220.

11443.text:
11443 vásā ( vasā́ - TS., vaśā - AitBr.) f. 'fat, grease' VS., 'brain' Kathās. [K., like Av. vaηhā -, indicates earlier - s -] Pa. Pk. vasā - f. 'fat' (Pk. also 'marrow'); K. was f.
'marrow, brain'; S. waha f. 'fat, grease, blubber of
fish'; Ku. baso 'fat', gng. bwas , N. boso ; Or. basā 'fat,
suet'. * vasaguḍa -. Addenda: vásā-: WPah.poet. bɔ̈̄ f. (obl. - a ) f. 'fat, grease'.

9712.text:
9712 majján-, gen. maj ( j ) ñáḥ m. 'marrow, pith' RV., majjā́ - f. ŚBr., majjas - n. Suśr. 2. * majjhra-. [The
phonetic changes to explain the various forms in MIA.
and NIA., summarized with lit. in EWA ii 550, are not
entirely satisfactory, being all of an occasional, not
regular, character: Pa. - iñj - < - ajj - (whereas normally - ajj - remains), metathesis of aspirate in bhejj - < mijjh - and development of e < i . Survival of an orig. IA.
aspirate jjh < IE. zgh (P. Tedesco Lg 19, 18, JAOS 67,
88) has some additional support in Kal. But other
agencies may have been at work: taboo, as with 'spleen'
and 'liver', or contamination with other words, such as mḗdas - ~ bhejj -, N. mās (< māṁsá -) ~ māsi ?] 1. majján -, °jā́ -: Pk. majjā - f. 'marrow, fat'; Kho. muž 'marrow'; S. maj̄ālo m. 'brain' (+?); B. māj , māij 'core or pith of a plant', māj-kāṭh 'heart-wood';
Or. mañja 'heart-wood', mañjā 'pith of plaintain plant';
H. mā̃j m. 'pus, matter'; Si. mada-ya , madulla 'kernel or
pulp or flesh of a fruit'; Md. madu 'marrow'; — majjñ -:
Dm. mā́nũ 'marrow' NTS xii 178, Kal.rumb. muñ ; — mijj -: S. mij̄a f. 'marrow, brain', L. (Ju.) mij̄ f., mult., mijj f., P. mij f.; G. mīc f. (with abnormal - c ); — miñj -: Pa. miñjā - f., °ja - n. 'marrow, kernel', tēla-miñjaka - 'kernel
of oil-seed'; Pk. miṁjā - f. 'marrow, fat'; S. miña , miñu f.
'marrow, brain'; G. mī˜j f. 'kernel'; Si. midulu 'marrow'
H. Smith JA 1950, 196; — mijjh -, miñjh -: L.awāṇ. mìjh (< * mhijh ), mijh 'marrow', P. mijjh , miñjh f. (cf.
L. mẽjh f. 'fat', WPah.bhal. mὲnj̈ f. s.v. mēdya -); — bhejj -: P. bhejjā m. 'brain, marrow'; H. bhejā m.
'marrow'; G. bhejũ n. 'brain, intellect'; — X māṁsá -:
N. māsi (see also māṁsi -); — X mastíṣka -: S. mikha f.
'marrow, brain'? 2. Kal.urt. bhrānz 'marrow'. Addenda: majján- [ a < non-apophonic IE. o (OSl. moždanŭ ,
etc.) T. Burrow BSOAS xxxviii 69] WPah.kṭg. m ī nj̈ f. 'fat', m i nj̈ɔ m. 'brain'; A. mazā 'core, inner part'.
